purpose: Corrected r2 rerun of the development-only deterministic numerical public-prefix minimum-norm checkpoint heuristic after pinning HiGHS dual-simplex presolve=false. It is not confirmatory evidence, a qualification procedure, or paper output.

generator.implementation: reuse unchanged v2_calibration, v2_simulator, and v2_disclosure modules
generator.strict_k_partitions: independently recomputed for every tested k

attacker.equalities: every released cumulative checkpoint share total through the horizon
attacker.inequalities: per-eligible-id no-overdraft after every modeled action
attacker.tail_policy: actions after the last completed checkpoint through the horizon receive zero abstention and do not update positions
attacker.runtime_dependency_policy: Permitted: the already pinned NumPy/SciPy runtime, including SciPy HiGHS and SLSQP. Prohibited: additional or new solver packages, native installations, alternate solver backends, or solver fallbacks.

claim_boundary: Deterministic numerical public-prefix minimum-norm heuristic only. It is neither an exact or certified solver, an optimal-attacker result, nor a privacy theorem.
